articles.summary: FREEHOLD, NJ, Nov. 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - UMH Properties, Inc. (NYSE: UMH; TASE: UMH), a real estate investment trust (REIT) specializing in the ownership and operation of manufactured home communities, is pleased to announce that on November 18, 2026, Eugene W. Landy, Founder and Chairman of the Board, was honored with the MHInsider Legacy Award, which recognizes manufactured housing professionals whose overall career contributions are certain to create meaningful and lasting industry improvement and excellence. UMH Properties, Inc., which was organized in 1968, is a public equity REIT that currently owns and operates 145 manufactured home communities containing approximately 27,300 developed homesites, of which 11,400 contain rental homes, and over 1,000 self-storage units. These communities are located in New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Indiana, Maryland, Michigan, Alabama, South Carolina, Florida and Georgia. articles.summary: FREEHOLD, NJ, Nov. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - UMH Properties, Inc. (NYSE:UMH) (TASE:UMH) reported Total Income for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 of $74.1 million as compared to $66.9 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2025, representing an increase of 11%. Net Loss Attributable to Common Shareholders amounted to $2.1 million or $0.02 per diluted share for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 as compared to Net Income Attributable to Common Shareholders of $4.2 million or $0.05 per diluted share for the quarter ended September 30, 2025. Normalized Funds from Operations Attributable to Common Shareholders (“Normalized FFO”), was $22.1 million or $0.26 per diluted share for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, as compared to $21.3 million or $0.25 per diluted share for the quarter ended September 30, 2025, representing an increase of 4% on both a dollar basis and on a per diluted share basis.
